summary: Documents GCP organization policy governance constraints referenced from Terraform source, but leaves all controls unenforced in OPA because the markdown explicitly marks values, enforcement modes, scope, and module implementations as unconfirmed.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This pack intentionally defines no enforceable plan checks because the source standard does not provide confirmed resource attributes or allowed/denied values.
